title: Teodoro
description:
Help Teodoro
Teodoro must solve sokoban puzzles to restore beauty to Peaceful Forest.Restore Flowers Altars
Reactivate all Flowers Altars to restore Flower Power.Don't step on the grass
Remember to not step on the grass!

Teodoro is an game with some simple and beautiful hand-drawn art. In the Peaceful forest Teodoro must reactivate all Flowers Altars to restore flower power resolving puzzles problems.

Features
• 50 sokoban puzzles [+ 30 bonus levels]

• Change Peaceful forest color palette

• Peaceful music

• Achievements support
description_short: Adorable sokoban classic puzzle game with some simple plus and beautiful hand-drawn art. Help Teodoro to restore all flowers Altars in the Peaceful Forest.
